launches.tagline: Porter brings the magical experience of deploying applications with a few clicks into your own cloud account.
launches.body:
**TLDR -** [Porter](https://porter.run) is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) that runs in your own cloud. It brings the magical experience of deploying your applications with a few clicks into your own cloud account. After a year since we closed down our self-serve flow, we are opening Porter back up for self-serve today.

* [Sign up here](https://dashboard.getporter.dev) and start deploying applications on your own infrastructure that scales with you.
* [Claim $10,000 in credits](https://gcpjnf9adme.typeform.com/to/lHMQdJYb) if your company is enrolled in YC Startup School. Along with the AWS credits you can claim from Startup School, this deal effectively lets you deploy on a PaaS for free - it’s like using Heroku with your AWS credits!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71916&key=user_uploads/323071/cc2f3fac-340f-4f39-9e4d-533f7ab40053)

## **What is Porter?**

Hi everyone,

We are Trevor and Justin from [Porter](https://porter.run/). We first launched Porter almost 2 years ago - a lot has happened since then, and today we’re excited to re-launch our product and share our story so far.

**For those of you who aren’t familiar:**

_Porter is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) that runs in your own cloud. You just link up your Git Repository, and Porter will deploy it into your own AWS/GCP/Azure account. Under the hood, it runs your apps on a Kubernetes cluster that’s been battle-tested against real life incidents so you can scale on the same kind of infrastructure that growth-stage companies run without any DevOps work._

## **The PaaS Graduation Problem**

Many startups first get started on a PaaS like Heroku to move quickly without worrying about infrastructure. However, most of these companies end up migrating to their own cloud infrastructure at some point, because their applications need more flexibility as they scale (they “graduate” from their PaaS provider). Moving off production applications off a PaaS is time-consuming and difficult, and hosting all of your infrastructure on in-house solutions of a single PaaS vendor comes with the risk of getting locked in.

Porter hits the sweet spot between simplicity and flexibility by allowing startups to deploy into their own cloud infrastructure with the convenience of a PaaS. Get started on Porter just as easily as you would on a traditional PaaS, then customize your infrastructure freely as you grow. Under the hood, Porter runs a Kubernetes cluster with the same kind of architecture that growth-stage companies build out with an army of infra engineers, so you don’t have to worry about outgrowing the infrastructure.

## **Opening back up for self-serve**

**Porter was originally open for self-serve when we first launched.** We onboarded a lot of companies through the self-serve flow in the beginning, but after a few months quickly realized that we didn’t have the resources to properly manage the Kubernetes clusters that are distributed across different cloud accounts at scale.

This led us to the difficult decision of shutting down our self-serve function and focusing on larger growth-stage companies that warrant the scalability of Kubernetes. This strategy worked well - we incrementally moved upmarket, quickly grew our revenue, and even onboarded a few public companies.

After a year since the initial launch, however, something fascinating started happening; some of the seed-stage companies we’ve onboarded in the beginning started to reach true scale on Porter. [Writesonic](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/writesonic) (YC S21), who first started on Porter during their YC batch, now runs a Kubernetes cluster with 1.5 _Terabytes_ of RAM without a single full-time infra engineer. [Memberstack](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/memberstack) (S20) routinely handles more than a million requests a day processing >$5M in payments every month, and [OneShop](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/oneshop) (S21) runs 60 different integration services on Porter. The list goes on.

Because we had been building a product for larger companies, our platform evolved on many axes to accommodate projects that are running at true scale - and we have lived long enough to witness companies who initially had tiny workloads on Porter organically grow into a scale that we’ve never even imagined.

We took the learnings from this experience and are opening Porter back up for self-serve with two key improvements:

1. With a new onboarding and deployment flow, getting started on Porter is truly just as easy as using a traditional PaaS like Heroku or Render. **The only difference** is that you need to connect your cloud account and wait 30 minutes for infrastructure to be provisioned.

   ![](https://www.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=71916&key=user_uploads/323071/890e143d-5d10-4138-9c8e-aeb05a89d420)

2. We’ve built out an internal system that oversees and manages the Kubernetes clusters that are distributed across different cloud accounts, so we are now ready to support a self-serve motion at scale.

You can [get started here](https://dashboard.getporter.dev). If you’re enrolled in YC Startup School, [claim $10k in credits here](https://gcpjnf9adme.typeform.com/to/lHMQdJYb).

Altro (altro.io) is a platform that enables members to build credit no matter who they are, where they are from, or their history of credit access/score. We serve the 68M people in the US (mainly Women and POC) who are denied credit due to historical bias and the lack of access that current banks provide to credit building and tools. (It wasn't until The Equal Credit Opportunity Act in the 1970's that Women and "Minorities" could even get fair access to credit)!


Altro has created a mobile that allows anyone to have access to credit, using their subscriptions as a means to start building their credit score. Altro lends to members a $75 Line of Credit to pay for their subscriptions, such as Netflix, Hulu, HelloFresh, etc. This card is built to solely work on the subscriptions that the member is already paying for, allowing them to securely use their $75 credit to build their credit using things they are already paying for.

Doing this empowers folx who were denied credit a way to start building their score and financial power. Altro will service millions of people in not only building their credit, but also gaining access to the tools (such as personal loans, emergency funds, car/house loans and more) that they could not access prior.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: The core idea behind Roboflow is that engineers need tools to build and deploy custom computer vision solutions to production. Each computer vision use case is unique, team competencies vary, and level of customization required is different. While there are many independent variables, all computer vision solutions have a common pipeline: collect data, manage data, label data, process data, train a model, deploy the model, and display results. Roboflow provides tools for each step in that process and integrates with your existing solutions so you can tailor your pipeline to meet your needs. We take an extensible and interoperable approach to tools which lets you do things like easily implement a new open source framework, programming language, or technology into your pipeline, whenever you need it. question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
The idea began in October 2012 on a bus from Jakarta to Bogor.

When the bus stopped for fuel, Fulcher noticed an older woman, a man, and a young child washing up with water from a roadside gutter. Meanwhile, a low-cost Android phone in the woman’s hand streamed YouTube.

Fulcher was shocked at the juxtaposition. How is 3G internet available on affordable smartphones but basic medical care not accessible? If mobile video could reach an ordinary phone, could a doctor do the same?

Before the bus reached Bogor, Fulcher had begun writing the first lines of what would become RingMD code. Over the following weeks, he hacked together a prototype and started going door to door at hospitals and clinics in Singapore to onboard physicians. The first version was a simple directory of doctors, with photographs, consultation prices, professional experience, and résumé information.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?

RingMD’s mission is to help bring access to affordable healthcare to as many people as possible.  RingMD works with governments to power their public health programs to extend their reach and impact.

launches.title: QuestDB - Purpose built database for financial market data
launches.tagline: High speed ingestion, millisecond queries, and open formats.
launches.body:
### TL;DR

[QuestDB Enterprise](https://questdb.io/enterprise) is now Generally Available. Everything from high-performance QuestDB Open Source, with advanced security and access features. Scale the globe with multi-primary writes and highly-available fault tolerance. Tiered storage and open formats, with Parquet files stored on Azure Blow or AWS S3.

[Try the QuestDB Live Demo](https://demo.questdb.io/) with billions of rows!

QuestDB Bring Your Own Cloud is now in Beta. We’ll announce GA in the coming months.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72748&key=user_uploads/432980/3963b213-4696-40ad-8e23-69cb912138d5)

### The Problem

Existing time-series databases lack performance and store data in their proprietary format, leading to vendor lock-in.

None is tailored for financial market data, which requires low-latency ingestion protocols, fast queries, and a dedicated set of features and functions.

### The Solution

**How does it work?**

QuestDB is built from scratch for time series and financial market data. The data is natively indexed by timestamp and partitioned by time. Queries are multi-threaded and heavily optimized, leveraging modern CPU instructions (SIMD). QuestDB's ingestion speed can reach up to 4M rows/sec per instance.

Vendor lock-in is avoided since historical data is automatically transformed into Parquet format and stored on Object Store. QuestDB Enterprise can query real-time data and historical data seamlessly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72748&key=user_uploads/432980/d26f7093-036a-41f3-9775-b19dff3c3cba)

Features that make QuestDB the best fit for trading/crypto applications include:

* Data deduplication that does not slow down ingestion
* Materialized Views (can be cascaded and chained)
* Native financial functions (vwap, order book fills, spread, weighted mid price etc…)
* Data compression with ZFS and Parquet
* Arrays to store order books (coming soon!)
* Apache Arrow (ADBC) for data scientists (coming soon!)
* Supports Postgres Wire and InfluxDB Line Protocol

# Production Deployments & Flagship Customers

OKX, B3 Exchange, Aquis Exchange (SIX Exchange), Mizuho Bank, Nomura (Laser Digital), One Trading, Energetech, AsiaNext, Airtel, XRP Ledger, Airbus, ABL Space Systems, Welwing Capital, Norlys Energy Trading, Beeks Group

name: Hypermile
long_description:
Hypermile is on a mission to improve trucking efficiency, sustainability and safety by developing an AI driver assistance system 🚛 🌎🌱.

Today, fuel is the main cost component for logistics operators, accounting for >1/3 of all operating costs. Driving behavior is a key factor affecting overall fuel consumption and can increase fuel use by up to 35%. However, current solutions are not cost effective, so logistics operators are constantly looking for new solutions. 

In addition, logistics operators are under huge sustainability pressure, as Heavy Goods Vehicles (HGVs) are responsible for 16% of the UK's transport emissions but only 5% of the miles travelled. While electric vehicle sales for passenger vehicles are on the rise, the same can't be said for long-haul HGVs due to high initial cost and limited range, making it impractical for logistic purposes. 

With this problem in mind, we aim to leverage the latest AI techniques to improve the fuel efficiency of diesel trucks today, and increase the range of zero-emission trucks of the future. 

Our product Hypermile Co-Pilot is a retrofittable AI cruise control for commercial vehicles focused on controlling the speed of the truck efficiently. We have trained the AI algorithms to learn the best techniques for saving fuel: anticipating how traffic flow will change, optimising speed based on the road gradient and maximizing vehicle coasting. name: Explorex
long_description:
Explorex — The Memory Layer for Physical Commerce

~90% of Indian retail happens in person, yet offline venues have no memory of their customers. Restaurants run on disconnected tools, and every visit ends with zero data captured. Explorex fixes this by owning both sides of the dining transaction.

At the center is Elite, our consumer app that is redefining how people dine out. Diners see live table availability, browse dynamic menus, order, and self-checkout instantly — no waiting, no interruptions. Behind it sits our infrastructure stack: Bridge OS (the full-stack restaurant operating system), Clyro (WhatsApp-native CRM), and ReserveX — all feeding a single behavioral data layer.

That data layer is what makes Explorex fundamentally different. Delivery platforms only see orders. We capture real-world, in-venue behavior — what people order, how long they stay, how groups behave, how menus perform, how experiences shape spending. Because we operate the restaurant OS and the consumer touchpoint, this data is irreplicable.

We're now building Elara, an AI dining concierge that turns this data into real-time decision-making — factoring intent, context, availability, and historical behavior. This moves us beyond discovery into becoming the intelligence layer for offline commerce.

Today, Explorex powers 250+ partner restaurants and 3M+ diners across Bangalore and Hyderabad, processing 8M+ transactions annually (18M+ lifetime), and operates at breakeven.

Explorex is not a SaaS tool — it is the infrastructure layer for offline dining, with AI and consumer experience at its core. Think Shopify for restaurants, on its way to becoming the UPI of restaurant operations.
one_liner: Ecosystem Platform for Restaurants in India

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Pritam and I met at IIT Kharagpur and became close friends long before we became co-founders. What pulled us into building together was a shared frustration: the biggest problems around us weren't hidden — they were so normalized that nobody saw them anymore.

Dining out was the perfect example. Waving down staff to order, waiting for the bill, restaurants running on disconnected tools with zero memory of their customers — everyone had accepted this as just "how restaurants work." We couldn't unsee it. The entire offline dining experience was broken, and because it had always been broken, no one was fixing it.

We decided to become founders because these status-quo problems don't get solved by incumbents — they require someone naive enough to question the default. That conviction became Explorex.

question_answers.answer: We decided to Apply to YC because we were very much inspired by Airbnb. We applied 4 times total and got rejected 3 times, each of those rejections only kept making us better and helped us understand our business and customers better.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: We have come a long way, became profitable, seen every phase succeed so far.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
\~90% of Indian retail happens in person, yet offline venues have no memory of their customers. A restaurant that has served someone fifty times knows less about them than an e-commerce site they visited once. This is the core problem: offline commerce is data-blind.

For restaurants, this means running on disconnected tools — one system for billing, another for reservations, spreadsheets for everything else — with no way to know who their customers are, what they love, or why they stopped coming. For diners, it means friction everywhere: flagging down staff to order, waiting for the bill, and a dining experience that hasn't fundamentally changed in decades.

It's a big problem because of the sheer scale of what's being left on the table. Food services in India is a massive market, and it operates with almost none of the intelligence that transformed online commerce. Delivery platforms captured the \~10% of eating that happens at home; the 90% that happens inside venues remains a black box.

We decided to work on it because the problem was obvious but invisible — it had been the status quo for so long that nobody questioned it. We realized that solving it requires owning both sides: the restaurant's operating system and the consumer's touchpoint. That's hard, which is exactly why it hasn't been done — and why it becomes an irreplicable moat once you do.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Our vision is to build the memory layer for physical commerce — starting with dining.

If we truly succeed, walking into a restaurant will feel like the internet already works: the venue knows you, the experience is personalized, ordering and paying are frictionless, and an AI concierge (Elara) guides you to the best possible experience before you even decide where to go. Discovery, decision, and transaction collapse into one intelligent layer.

For restaurants, success means every independent venue in India operates with the data sophistication of an e-commerce giant — understanding their customers, optimizing their menus, and reaching high-intent diners directly instead of renting them from aggregators at punishing take rates. Think Shopify for restaurants: infrastructure that makes the merchant more powerful, not more dependent.

And dining is just the beachhead. The same problem — physical venues with no memory of their customers — exists across all of offline retail. If we win dining, we become the intelligence layer for offline commerce broadly: the UPI of physical retail operations, a shared infrastructure that makes the real world as smart as the digital one.

The world that results is one where the 90% of commerce that happens in person is no longer invisible — where physical businesses finally compete on equal footing with digital ones.

Even well-managed IT teams find it hard to track all software being used across departments.

**How does Swif’s Chrome Extension fix this?** Our Chrome Extension helps you automatically identify and monitor employee access to unauthorized SaaS apps. With **real-time visibility**, Swif detects email and password sign-ups to unapproved apps, enabling IT teams to track usage, ensure compliance, and take action quickly—before a security risk escalates. The extension fits seamlessly into your existing IT workflow, providing a single dashboard for comprehensive oversight.

Swif’s strength lies in its automation. Instead of manually hunting down unapproved apps, our extension monitors usage, generates compliance reports, and offers automated solutions for securing access. This gives you control without adding complexity, saving both time and resources.

We saw firsthand how much of a challenge it is to maintain visibility over what employees are using, especially in remote and hybrid work environments. launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64193&key=user_uploads/364633/589b9712-0cb1-49cd-9bf5-e059435f1451)

Hey! We’re Colin & Lyn from [webapp.io](http://webapp.io).

We’re helping webapp developers make new copies of their stack in seconds using memory snapshots. You can think of a cloud-agnostic, full-stack version of the branch deployments you’d get from Vercel, Netlify, Heroku, or Render - even if you’re using a regular cloud provider instead of a PaaS.

[Webapp.io](http://Webapp.io) lets you create full-stack environments for every pull request in seconds. We’ve built a custom hypervisor that watches which files are used in which build steps, and skips repetitive actions like starting microservices, seeding databases, or building images.

It came out of our own frustrations from having to often skip end-to-end testing for commits just for the sake of developer velocity. A typo fix on a landing page shouldn’t take 15+ minutes to spin up a fresh environment for some Cypress tests!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64193&key=user_uploads/364633/abdf8553-ec80-4b7a-9582-62e95d43cbc7)

[Webapp.io](http://Webapp.io) works with any Linux-based stack, and the configuration works like a Dockerfile for VMs so that you can get started without having to talk to support.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64193&key=user_uploads/364633/4e3f5b2c-3215-41ef-851d-5e46a72727d7)

Once you’ve installed our app on your GitHub, GitLab, or BitBucket profile, you can push files called Layerfile in the syntax above, and we’ll automatically discover them and build your environments.

[Webapp.io](http://Webapp.io) builds new VMs by re-using memory snapshots of your earlier builds. That means you can get a fresh copy of your database, microservices, and backend in seconds for a frontend change 10x faster than a production cloud provider or traditional CI.

Our free tier is generous and we’re happy to set up a shared slack channel to help prospective users get set up. [Try out the product here!](https://webapp.io/sign-up?utm_src=launchyc) or [read the docs](https://webapp.io/docs/?utm_src=launchyc).

name: Osmind
long_description:
Osmind is the premier platform for clinicians and researchers advancing new life-saving mental health treatments. Today, mental health disorders are one of the leading causes of death worldwide, especially among young adults, and are tied to shortening lifespans. While there have been developments in new psychiatric medications since the first FDA approval in 1954, today there is a growing movement among clinicians, patients, and researchers who are recognizing the need to accelerate new science.

The Osmind treatment platform is the first and only solution that solves specific challenges faced by neuropsychiatric clinics, spanning general psychiatry and interventional psychiatry (transcranial magnetic stimulation, ketamine, SPRAVATO®, psychedelic medicine, electroconvulsive therapy). The core electronic health record (EHR) technology is precisely developed for interventional treatment workflows and designed to support a strong therapeutic alliance, including journaling tools and assistance with health plan reimbursement, which is a significant access hurdle for millions of patients.

Research from our platform is already helping to set new standards for mental health interventions. For example, in the largest published real-world analysis of ketamine infusion therapy for depression, we teamed up with Stanford University School of Medicine to share findings in the Journal of Affective Disorders (March 2022). We have multiple ongoing research studies leveraging our proprietary real-world data, including an even larger ketamine analysis leveraging machine learning to predict treatment outcomes.

Osmind is a San Francisco–based public benefit corporation led by scientists, technologists, and psychiatrists. We are backed by top investors including DFJ Growth, General Catalyst, Future Ventures, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator.

launches.tagline: Launching global payments & treasury from GIFT city for the world.
launches.body:
Hey YC community, we’re Rohit and team from **Decentro (YC S20)**, a full‑stack banking and payments API player from India.

Over the last few years, we’ve helped thousands of businesses plug into Indian banking, KYC, and payments infrastructure with simple APIs; now we’re extending that to global payments with our new **GIFT‑based PSP** and cross‑border collection stack.

## **The problem – global money in & out**

If you’re a trade finance player, marketplace, or fintech scaling globally, you probably live in some version of this mess:

* Multiple PSPs and bank partners across countries, each with different compliance, FX, and payout rules.
* Long, opaque onboarding cycles for cross‑border flows.
* Fragmented reporting across acquirers, currencies, and entities, making reconciliation and compliance audits painful.
* A fast‑moving regulatory environment (IFSCA, FEMA, local regimes) where a misstep can mean blocked flows or penalties.

This slows down companies that should be focusing on building products and acquiring customers, not chasing bank RM emails and interpreting circulars.

## **What we’re building – a compliant global PSP rail via GIFT**

We’ve become one of the first Indian payment aggregators to receive a final PSP license from IFSCA at GIFT City, and we’re wrapping that into a developer‑first global payments platform.

At a high level, here’s how it works:

* Single API / dashboard to collect global payments: Accept from international customers via cards, local methods, and bank transfers across multiple currencies, and settle into GIFT City or onshore INR.
* Built‑in compliance and reporting: We abstract GIFT City PSP rules, documentation, and transaction reporting so finance and compliance teams get ready‑to‑use exports and views.
* Faster settlement and better visibility: Unified ledgers and payout flows across corridors and partners, with clear T+ timelines, FX details, and status notifications.
* Modular APIs: Use us just as a cross‑border collection layer, or plug into the broader Decentro stack (KYC, domestic payouts, banking APIs) if you want a full‑stack infra partner.

launches.title: Tidepool 🌊 - Product analytics for AI apps
launches.tagline: With Tidepool, product teams can find patterns in their user text interactions to help make better product decisions.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=73360&key=user_uploads/486120/59d0da6d-3ebf-4b0c-a977-52e9dcd90847)

**TLDR: Excited to announce our new product,** [**Tidepool**](https://www.tidepool.so/)! Tidepool does product analytics for AI text interfaces. With Tidepool, product teams can find patterns in their user text interactions to help make better product decisions.

[**Check our our demo video here!**](https://youtu.be/Ss-zLj53OlM)

### **The Problem:**

LLM apps have introduced [**a new paradigm**](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ai-paradigm/) for interacting with software, where users can work iteratively with the software via a natural language interface, generating user inputs and model responses consisting of unstructured text.

Traditional product analytics techniques don't deal well with large amounts of unstructured text - it's hard to summarize, it's hard to aggregate, and it's hard to effectively sample. AI developers resort to digging through a pile of hundreds to hundreds of millions of datapoints of unstructured text to understand how users interact with their product.

### **The Solution:**

[**Tidepool**](https://www.tidepool.so/) is a product analytics platform that solves these problems using **neural network embeddings**. After you upload user text interaction events, Tidepool will:

1. **Automatically group your data by similarity.** Tidepool runs embedding clustering on your users’ text interactions to surface interesting attributes: things like prompt topics, prompt languages, and common usage patterns that can be turned into shortcuts.
2. **Summarize common attributes in your data**, using LLMs to determine what each cluster “contains.” For example, understanding that the most common topics that users discuss are business, education, and art.
3. **Track attributes in production traffic**, allowing you to uncover how a specific attribute might be correlated to good / bad product outcomes. We utilize lightweight models running on foundation model embeddings to scalably extract these attributes from hundreds of millions of production interaction events.

### **About Us:**

Over the last few years, Aquarium has worked a lot with computer vision companies to help them curate labeled datasets and improve their fine-tuned models using our core embedding technology.

Our mission has always been to make it easier for people to build and improve production ML systems that solve real-world problems. When we saw the Cambrian explosion of LLM apps earlier this year, we realized that our core embedding technology and expertise was very useful for getting these new apps to product-market fit even faster!

### **Our Ask:**

* **Try it out!** [Sign up here to get started.](https://www.tidepool.so/)
* **Share this post with your friends!** We’d love to get exposure to as many different AI applications as possible.
* **Give us feedback!** [Join our Slack community](https://join.slack.com/t/tidepoolcommunity/shared_invite/zt-1zp4f82tc-78rxSFZ6E3eXguvH3pzdwQ) and leave your thoughts, or [schedule some time with us to talk](https://calendly.com/pgao/tidepool-demo).

I’m [Amine](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bengeekly/), CTO of Mailwarm (YC S20) and today we’re launching [mailX](https://themailx.com).\

Today we’re launching [mailX](https://themailx.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101509&key=user_uploads/422675/836ee2bb-f82d-4b97-9c90-c77c6d0d62f0)

---

## TL;DR

**mailX tells you why your emails go to spam and how to fix it.**\
You can run a deliverability check from the web, use it through a JSON API, or plug it directly into AI agents through MCP.

No signup.\
No API key.\
Free to use.

Try it here: [**https://themailx.com**](https://themailx.com)\
MCP endpoint: [**https://themailx.com/mcp**](https://themailx.com/mcp)

---

You can also book a call with one of our email deliverability expert [HERE](https://calendly.com/mailwarmsessions/mailx).

## 🚨 The Problem

Email deliverability is technical, your marketing team can’t handle it.

Email is still one of the most important growth channels for startups.

Founders use it for cold outreach.\
Sales teams use it for outbound.\
Marketing teams use it for campaigns.\
Products use it for onboarding, activation, and transactional emails.

But when emails start going to spam, most teams don’t really know why.

They check random tools.\
They look at raw DNS records.\
They ask ChatGPT.\
They change things blindly.\
They wait and hope inbox placement improves.

The problem is not only that deliverability is technical.

The real problem is that most tools show data, but don’t explain what matters or what to fix.

And now, with AI agents sending emails, monitoring systems, and managing workflows, this problem gets bigger.

Agents need access to live deliverability tools too.

---

## 💡Our Solution

**mailX is a free deliverability diagnostic platform for humans and AI agents.**

With mailX, you can analyze a domain in seconds and get a clear report showing:

* What is working
* What is broken
* Why it matters
* What to fix next

The web app gives founders, marketers, sales teams, and developers a simple way to understand why emails may go to spam.

The API and MCP server make the same tools available to AI agents and developer workflows.

So instead of copying DNS records into different tools, your agent can directly check email authentication, blacklist status, mail server configuration, and deliverability signals.

---

## ⏳How it works

1. Enter a domain on [**themailx.com**](http://themailx.com)
2. mailX runs a live deliverability audit
3. You get clear issues, explanations, and fixes
4. Developers can use the JSON API
5. AI agents can use the MCP endpoint directly

The best part is that you can lets you AI Agent fix your deliverability or directly integrate it to your Claude or ChatGPT.

Here’s a quick demo of mailX:\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YWmV7-wthQI>

In the demo, we show:

* Running a domain audit
* Getting clear fixes
* Using the MCP/API layer for AI agents and developers

We currently support checks and tools for email authentication, DNS records, blacklist status, mail server configuration, and record generation.

---

## Why now?

Email deliverability used to be something only email experts cared about.

Today, every startup relying on outbound, lifecycle emails, AI SDRs, or automated email workflows needs to understand it.

At the same time, AI agents are becoming part of the stack.

But agents need tools.\
They need live data.\
They need safe, structured ways to diagnose and act.

That’s why we made mailX available through:

* Web app
* JSON API
* MCP server
* Agent skill
* LLM discovery endpoints

Our belief is simple:

**Email deliverability should be understandable for humans and usable by AI agents.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101509&key=user_uploads/422675/ffc97aad-6864-4525-a89d-0aa1f7890289)

---

## Backstory

In 2019, we failed a startup after 2 years of work.

After that, we decided to test ideas much faster: one launch per week.

Every launch used the same growth channel: email.

Cold emails.\
Partnership emails.\
Launch emails.\
Follow-ups.

That’s when we understood something obvious: If your emails don’t land in the inbox, nothing else matters.

That led us to build Mailwarm in 2020.

After years helping thousands of teams improve deliverability, we kept seeing the same pattern: People don’t know why they land in spam.\
And even when they see the data, they don’t know what to fix.

mailX is our answer to that.

---

---

We’d love your feedback from the YC community.

If you are doing cold email, email marketing, transactional email, or building AI agents that send or monitor emails, try mailX and tell us what is missing.

launches.body:
Hello 👋

Nunzio and Sebastiano from [Akiflow](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/akiflow) here!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64891&key=user_uploads/117279/d0fe1c55-7cda-4899-9ac4-bb4866fbee19)

### 🚩 **The problem: staying organized is hard.**

Tasks are scattered around; they come from messaging apps (emails, slack, etc.), project management platforms, video calls, surfing the web, and constantly arise throughout the day. Furthermore, it's difficult to be realistic about how much work you can get done without a calendar that shows how much time you have in a day at work.

### **✨ The Solution:**

**Akiflow consolidates tasks in a single inbox from different apps** (Gmail, Slack, Todoist, Notion, Asana, Trello, ClickUp, and anything else via Zapier).

It makes it easy to capture tasks via our _command bar_ that can be opened anywhere on the device. The fully functional calendar supports tasks and it’s built for time blocking giving you a comprehensive view of your day/week.

_Our command bar_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64891&key=user_uploads/117279/b6cf5ab5-fa5f-43db-a928-2857d484a78a)

_Timezone support and Share Availability_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64891&key=user_uploads/117279/390022e0-c46c-44d0-af4d-2da1960e82d6)

_Booking Slots_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64891&key=user_uploads/117279/86540833-2140-4b96-93d5-3758e8125816)

_Notifications and Agenda_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64891&key=user_uploads/117279/b07d8bb3-8b8e-4e14-bd94-7be3abc910d4)


**👉 Start your free trial! Click** [**here 👈**](https://akiflow.com/)

### **🎞️  Our story**

When we started Akiflow, we build a way to quickly add information to different tools.

It was a command bar, similar to Alfred, that allowed users to add events to the calendar or create tasks on Asana, Trello, etc. 

We soon realized that all we were doing was speeding up people's attempts to manage their own subpar productivity system.

The ultimate goal of our users was to maintain constant organization by keeping everything in one place. Since they were unable to find an app that could assist them in doing so, they were trying to speed up the process of consolidating information manually.

That’s why we decided to pivot and build a unified tasks + calendars app. We built integrations (via APIs) with multiple sources of to-dos (Gmail, Slack, Asana, etc..).

We developed a full calendar experience, added shortcuts and a command bar (we kind of had this ready from Akiflow #1), and added a few features to accelerate routine tasks (join a call, share availability, ..)

launches.title: Warmly - Always-On AI Sales Agent for Your Website
launches.tagline: AI that gives demos, qualifies leads, and books meetings on your website 24/7
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋 We're Max, Carina and Alan, founders of Warmly.ai.

**TL;DR**: We just launched **AI Autopilot**: an always-on agent that lives on every page of your website, identifies visitors at the person level before any form fill, gives demos, qualifies prospects, books meetings, and retargets the rest. Customers running it are converting 30% more inbound traffic. Setup is a script tag and 30 minutes.

Launch announcement [here](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/) (would greatly appreciate a comment!).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EHybZmEzyTs>

**The Problem**

Most B2B SaaS companies are bleeding pipeline through their front door.

Your website is your highest-leverage asset. Every visitor you've paid for lands there. They often have the problem you solve but you just might not be fast enough to get to them in time before they leave or go to a competitor.

Buyers now expect to talk to someone immediately. They don’t want to wait a day to schedule a call with an SDR to get a basic question answered.

But every "AI chatbot" we've seen since 2023 has the same architecture under the hood: a stateless GPT wrapper that rebuilds context from scratch on every message, hallucinates, and hands off "qualified" leads with no traceability.

AEs aren’t fans and buyers see through them in two messages.

**What we built**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkvDdJCsqd8>

AI Autopilot is one agent on every page of your site. It pulls from your website, help center, internal docs, sales calls, sales methodologies, and CRM.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/3ec0d6d3-bdec-4a67-9c20-5937dd63216d)

It picks its own qualification path. It generates slide decks on the fly mid-conversation, triggers the right videos by intent, and offers an optional video avatar so visitors talk to a person instead of a widget.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/368692f0-3842-48b8-8297-2cdd41ab78d7)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/e3d90e0a-3c84-418b-b28e-445d7ee67dd4)

When the visitor doesn't book? AI Autopilot doesn't give up. It Slacks your team, sends a personalized follow-up email, and triggers LinkedIn retargeting for your top prospects.

It self-improves.

It analyzes every conversation against the goals you set, tunes itself, and is version controlled. You can watch it get better over time.

In our beta accounts, automated inbound meetings increased 30%.

**Why now**

We started out compiling signals for B2B sales/marketing teams, like person-level website visitor data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/49b7ce12-478d-4b6f-a812-7a0810f6272a)

In the past year we took a different bet: build a context graph for B2B GTM first, then put agents on top of it.

The context graph is a unified, real-time data layer that connects every signal, action, note, and outcome for every account. When AI Autopilot engages a visitor, it knows they saw your LinkedIn ad last week, your SDR sent a follow-up email yesterday, and they downloaded a case study an hour ago. It doesn't have to "look this up.” The context is already pre-computed in primitive stores it can query in milliseconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/784e00dd-623d-42b2-94e4-fc67416b54a0)

A blog post we wrote that covers how we think about the GTM space: [GTM Brain: Next Platform Owns Decisions, Not Data](https://www.warmly.ai/blog/gtm-brain).

**Asks for the YC community**

1\. **Drop us a comment on our [launch post](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/)**. We’d love for more of our community to know us for building GTM agents and not just supply GTM data :).

2\. **Try us out.** Book a demo with us if this is something you’re interested in! <https://www.warmly.ai/p/book-a-demo>

Warmly,

Max, Carina & Alan

He has a Ph.D. in economics and loves talking about correlation vs. causation.

# What is the Modern Data Stack and why does it matter?

We jokingly say that the Modern Data Stack is about 500 logos on a VC pitch deck slide. Navigating through the noise is challenging because many of the modern tools aim to solve advanced problems that most companies never encounter. Instead, we’ve optimized the data infrastructure onboarding experience to be achievable without any data engineers or experts.  Mozart will set up your data pipelines – seamlessly gluing world-class ELT, data warehousing, data transformation, data monitoring & alerting, cost-optimization, and governance all together for you. This gives you the full power of a modern data stack (Snowflake + Fivetran) even if all you know is some basic SQL, so you can focus on your specific product and business challenges.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70031&key=user_uploads/490519/fe251d78-d894-4e17-bfb9-10622d4ab9cb)

Early examples of analysis teams do with a Modern Data Stack:

* Set up an Investor Dashboard with core metrics using Metabase to visualize
* Set up Slack or email alerts when events happen in your application db
* Get your Salesforce/Stripe/Shopify data syncing to GSheets
* Reconcile how much each client is supposed to be paying and is actually paying
* Set up a test and alert that we have a first and last name for every client (or any other necessary condition)
* Push cleaned data about clients to a GSheet for customer service or operations teams to consume
* View basic product funnels with Segment data through your favorite BI tool
* Set up lead and churn (likelihood) scores for prospects and customers
* SQL query collaborative editing with version control backed by GitHub
* Save money on platforms that price based on seats with the same visibility into performance
* Set up your long-term data infrastructure that can scale cost-effectively

There are many reasons to get your data infrastructure set up early.  There are many quick wins from reporting, alerting, effective operations, governance, and cost-saving.  With tools like Mozart Data, you can do this without data engineers.  With our Sonata package, you can see the value in the data for yourself for FREE.

launches.title: ZeroStep - AI-assisted actions and assertions for Playwright tests
launches.tagline: ZeroStep's ai() function unlocks the power of GPT3.5 and GPT4 to make Playwright tests simpler and more resilient to change.
launches.body:
[**ZeroStep**](https://zerostep.com/) is a JavaScript library that adds the power of AI to Playwright tests. ZeroStep’s **ai()** function lets developers test a web application using simple plain-text instructions, embedded directly in their Playwright tests.

Here’s a complete Playwright test using ZeroStep that verifies the core “book a meeting” workflow in Calendly:

```javascript
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { ai } from '@zerostep/playwright'

test.describe('Calendly', () => {
  test('book the next available timeslot', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('https://calendly.com/zerostep-test/test-calendly')

    await ai('Verify that a calendar is displayed', { page, test })
    await ai('Dismiss the privacy modal', { page, test })
    await ai('Click on the first available day of the month', { page, test })
    await ai('Click on the first available time in the sidebar', { page, test })
    await ai('Click the Next button', { page, test })
    await ai('Fill out the form with realistic values', { page, test })
    await ai('Submit the form', { page, test })

    const element = await page.getByText('You are scheduled')
    expect(element).toBeDefined()
  })
})
```

Six months ago, we launched an AI “prompt” feature in [**Reflect**](https://reflect.run/), our low-code testing platform, that lets users execute actions and assertions from plain-text prompts. Since then, two-thirds of our customers have incorporated AI prompts into their Reflect tests. We’re convinced that AI will lead to a step change in how products are end-to-end tested, and want as many devs as possible to be able to take advantage of this new technology.

With ZeroStep, you can get the benefits of easy-to-write test steps and less flaky tests, with minimal changes to your existing Playwright testing workflow.

**The biggest benefits of ZeroStep are:**

* **Tests are easier to write**. Writing an ai() step is equivalent to describing the action (“Fill out the form with realistic values”), assertion (“Verify there are no errors displayed on the page”), or extraction (“What is the shopping cart total?”) in plain English. The AI does the rest. There’s no need to write selectors, or add data-test-id attributes all over your app so that your tests have stable locators. Our website and GitHub repo show several examples of tricky testing scenarios that are made easy with ZeroStep.
* **Tests are less frustrating to maintain**. Unlike selectors, ZeroStep ai() steps are not tightly coupled to your app’s markup. The ZeroStep AI interprets your ai() steps at runtime which means even large scale changes in the app won’t break your tests, so long as your functional requirements remain unchanged. Selectors, in my opinion, are one of the worst leaky abstractions in software development. I can’t imagine how many dev hours have been lost due to them. We’re happy to not use any concept of selectors with this approach.
* **It’s easy to ramp up**. ai() steps have no predefined syntax (unlike Cucumber). You just need to be able to clearly describe what action, assertion, or extraction you want the AI to perform.

**Our Ask:**

If your front-end developers write and maintain Playwright tests, and would benefit from tests being faster to write and easier to maintain, we think they’ll love ZeroStep.

We offer a generous free tier and it’s easy to get started. More information is available at <https://zerostep.com/> and our GitHub repo: <https://github.com/zerostep-ai/zerostep>

**TL;DR: We've launched the SiPhox Health GLP Monitoring Panel: at-home blood testing and body composition tracking built specifically for people on GLP-based therapy (Ozempic, Zepbound, Retatrutide, etc.).**

✅ Wearable integration — Apple Health, Oura, Whoop, Dexcom, Libre, etc.

✅ Upload third-party labs (Quest, Labcorp, etc.) for a complete picture in one dashboard

✅ $199 — HSA/FSA eligible

🔗 **Start monitoring:** <http://siphoxhealth.com/glp-monitoring>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102471&key=user_uploads/520037/2235ba82-46fe-42ad-a38b-c5fb7f65c2cd)

### 🔨 Why We Built This

# We're Getting Into the GLP Game — But Not With a Me-Too Product

30 million Americans are currently on GLP drugs. That number is going up. Access is getting easier, prices are falling, and the longevity research on low-dose GLP therapy is compelling enough that it's not hard to imagine most adults cycling on and off these medications eventually, not just for weight loss, but for metabolic health and lifespan.

There are plenty of places to buy Ozempic, but the monitoring and optimization infrastructure is not there yet. The biology of GLP therapy is more complicated than the weight loss headline suggests:

🚫 **Muscle loss is hidden by the scale.** Fast weight loss often means lean mass loss, not just fat. Standard weight tracking can't tell the difference.

🚫 **Side effects are downstream signals.** Fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, and constipation aren't random — they're often markers of caloric under-fueling, nutrient depletion, or dehydration pressure that bloodwork would catch early.

🚫 **Prescribers don't monitor the full picture.** Most GLP patients get minimal follow-up labs, if any. HbA1c, ApoB, ferritin, B12, testosterone, thyroid — none of these are standard-of-care during treatment.

🚫 **Weight alone is a bad success metric.** Losing 24 lbs while losing 6 lbs of muscle and depleting your ferritin is not the same as losing 24 lbs of fat.

# The Solution: A Monitoring Loop Built for GLP Therapy

We've served 50,000+ users with at-home blood testing. GLP users are a distinct population with distinct needs, so we built a product specifically for them. The SiPhox GLP Monitoring Panel connects labs, body composition, and symptom tracking into one continuous loop so you can see what the drug is actually doing to your biology and course-correct before small problems become bigger ones.

---

### 💡 What You Get

**✅ 40+ Lab Markers — GLP-Specific Panel**

Not a generic wellness panel. Built around the markers that matter when appetite, weight, hydration, and body composition are actively changing:

* **Metabolism:** HbA1c, eAG, C-Peptide
* **Lipids & heart:** ApoB, LDL, HDL, Triglycerides, hsCRP
* **Liver:** ALT, AST, ALP, bilirubin, albumin
* **Kidney & hydration:** BUN, creatinine, eGFR, BUN:Cr ratio
* **Thyroid:** TSH, Free T4
* **Hormones:** Testosterone (total + free + %), SHBG, cortisol
* **Nutrition:** Vitamin D, B12, folate, ferritin, iron studies (Iron, UIBC, TIBC, Iron Saturation), total protein

**✅ Painless At-Home Collection**

Collected via our Easydraw arm patch, no venous draw, no finger prick, no lab visit. Mail it back, and the results appear in your dashboard.

**✅ Body-Composition Scanning**

In-app scanner tracks fat loss vs. lean mass preservation between tests.

**✅ GLP Tolerance Score**

A composite score built from labs, body comp, and symptom check-ins. Tracks how well your body is handling therapy at each stage: baseline → titration → maintenance.

**✅ Symptom & Side-Effect Tracking**

Track fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, GI issues, and muscle soreness between tests. Connects subjective experience to objective lab data.

**✅ Detailed Analysis & Personalized Insights**

Interpret what's moving in the right direction, what deserves a conversation with your prescriber, and what to adjust in diet, training, or supplementation built around your specific results.

🔗 **Start monitoring:** <http://siphoxhealth.com/glp-monitoring>

---

---

### 📈 Why Now?

GLP drugs are the fastest-growing drug class in history. Next-gen peptides like retatrutide, orforglipron, cagrilintide are coming. The longevity use case is expanding the addressable population well beyond obesity treatment. And monitoring has not kept pace with any of it.

Most patients are flying blind. Prescribers don't have the bandwidth for individualized follow-up. Labs are ordered inconsistently, if at all. No one is connecting weight, body composition, symptoms, and biomarkers in a single continuous view.

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

### 🏢 For Businesses: White-Label the GLP Monitoring

Running a GLP prescribing platform, a metabolic health clinic, a wellness app, or a supplement brand with a GLP-adjacent audience? You can white-label or co-brand the entire monitoring program.

**What the partner program gives you:**

✅ White-label or co-branded kit and dashboard under your brand

✅ Full panel access + API integration for embedding results in your own product

✅ Partner dashboard to track your clients' health journeys and customize next steps with real biomarker data

✅ Pre/post protocol testing to prove efficacy and reduce churn

✅ CLIA/CAP-accredited lab processing — same quality as traditional venous draws

✅ Account management, biomarker interpretation training, and marketing support

Patients are 3x more likely to stay engaged with a health program backed by real biomarker data.

🔗 **Partner inquiry:** [siphoxhealth.com/partner](https://siphoxhealth.com/partner)

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

---

### 🤝 For Health Coaches: Refer and Earn

If you work with people on GLP therapy as a health coach, personal trainer, or content creator, our affiliate program is built for you.

No cost to join. No hidden fees. Your referrals get a better monitoring product and better outcomes; you get a meaningful revenue stream.

🔗 **Join the affiliate program:** [siphoxhealth.com/affiliate-program](https://siphoxhealth.com/affiliate-program)

---

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

### About SiPhox Health

SiPhox Health, backed by Khosla Ventures, Intel Capital, and Y Combinator, is a full-stack home blood testing company founded at MIT. We've tested 1M+ biomarkers across 50,000+ users. **TLDR:**

> “AI will cure all diseases in the next 10 years.” – Demis Hassabis, CEO of DeepMind (CBS 60 Minutes)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90232&key=user_uploads/520037/884209a7-485e-4a4f-8533-9904a6d38f8f)

Big claim. Maybe _too_ big.

Something more practical: AI + friction-free diagnostics can wipe out **a significant portion of preventable disease** if we give people the right tools.

That’s exactly what we’re shipping an early version of **today**.

---

### **What’s new**

# 1. **Cursor-style Copilot for Your Labs (Beta)**

Upload any lab report—PDF, photo, whatever—and **Sai**, our GPT-powered assistant, appears as a cursor-style sidebar in your dashboard.

Ask it anything:

* “Why is my ApoB high if my LDL looks fine?”
* “Show me habits that would drop my Trig/HDL under 2.”
* “Review my last several years of test data to see if I might be developing perimenopause.”
* “Generate a doctor-ready summary of my results.”

Or **highlight any section** in your dashboard and click _Ask Sai_

https://youtu.be/B7PZ3QvIEuI

# 2. **Zero-friction At-Home Blood Testing**

* Upper-arm collector (comfortable, collects the sample painlessly in a few minutes)
* Industry-leading, up to **50 biomarkers** in a single kit
* Overnight return shipping to lab for fast results.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90232&key=user_uploads/520037/c7d623a3-5648-489a-a0db-2d8b4b0e55d1)


# 3. **Integrated Expert Review**

Every report is reviewed by health experts. Insights come from a proprietary database developed by SiPhox experts and clinical advisors based on years of longitudinal testing by thousands of users. You still get human nuance + the flexibility of discussing your results with Sai.

# 4. **Free Biological-Age & Heart-Age Scores**

Because a comprehensive dashboard is nice, but **north-star metrics** make it easier to take action and track progress. We built these scores using proprietary models based on public datasets and years of SiPhox user data.

# 5. **Open Uploads**

Not ready to buy a kit? Start by dumping old Quest/Labcorp PDFs into the dashboard for **free**. We’ve had this feature available for a few months now, and uploads are growing exponentially.

---

### **One More Thing 🫀**

# **Heart & Metabolic Program** (launched quietly six months ago, now public)

* **Most complete at-home panel** for cardiometabolic risk (advanced lipids + insulin resistance markers).
* **Phenotype scoring** that fuses glucose-metabolism and lipid data
* American Heart Association risk score and SiPhox **Heart-Age** score so you (and your doctor) can see your heart health status at a glance.
* Access to titrated **lipid-lowering medications** when needed via telemedicine
* Full Sai access, of course.

---

### **Why We’re Doing This**

* **Doctors are time-constrained**. They glance at your test results and say “looks normal” even though “normal” ranges are based on lack of active disease, not disease prevention
* **Patients are guessing**. Reddit threads and WebMD are too generic
* **AI is finally good enough** to translate raw biomarker data into clear, day-to-day actions.
* **Existing doctor-AI tools** are focused on symptom analysis and diagnosis, not on labs and long-term disease prevention
* **60% of Americans have a chronic disease.** We want to help these people manage or even reverse their conditions and help the other 40% stay healthy long into old age.

### **“There’s a new AI agent/chatbot launching every day. Why does the world need another one?”**

1. It’s 100% true that anyone can upload their lab results to ChatGPT or another LLM interface and have a passable conversation about them. Based on our real-world experience with the SiPhox user-base, having a single health dashboard where all of your health data lives makes all the difference. **It’s the same reason Cursor is more useful for coding than ChatGPT…** the assistant in the IDE and has all the necessary context to collaborate with the user. This is something we wanted to experiment with (and we are looking to get as much feedback as possible on the UI).
2. ChatGPT and other chatbots do great on generic medical exams but just like a typical primary care physician, they are less trained to handle health optimization and advanced bloodwork. Selecting “deep research” gives better results, but the output still requires an expert to confirm.
3. SiPhox customized Sai using years of experience repeatedly testing, and coaching tens of thousands of users. This kind of dataset of frequent, comprehensive testing and coaching doesn’t exist publicly (or privately, as far as we know) for LLMs to train on.
4. We are not an AI company building in a vacuum; we are a hardware and clinical product company building, integrating AI to serve the needs of active users who partner with us every day to improve their health.

**Transparently, we are not convinced that this form factor (a chatbot)** is the final iteration, but given the state of AI today (latency vs. accuracy and intelligence tradeoffs), this is where we are starting.

---

### [TALK TO SAI](https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai)

1. **Don’t forget to upload past labs** → your data and trends are analyzed and displayed in a clear dashboard with the Sai sidebar\_: [https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai](https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai%5C)
2. **Sign up for a home blood test kit subscription** → 20 % off for the YC community with code [LAUNCHYC20](https://siphoxhealth.com/?discount=LAUNCHYC20)
3. Are you a business, healthtech startup, clinic, physician or coach? You can utilize all of these features in SiPhox Enterprise, co-branded or white-labeled: https://siphoxhealth.com/partner

---

Ten years to cure all diseases is optimistic, but giving everyone a personal lab analyst today is how we start making progress.

See you in the dashboard,

The SiPhox Health team

\_________________________________________________________________\_

### **How is my data handled?**

SiPhox does not sell or share your personal data. SiPhox maintains compliance with industry grade security and best data privacy standards.

\_________________________________________________________________\_

### **The disclaimer:**

Sai is an AI-powered assistant (Beta) developed by SiPhox to provide general informational and educational responses based on its training data. Like other AI models (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini), Sai may occasionally generate incomplete, outdated, or inaccurate information. We are actively working to improve its performance and reliability.

Sai does **not** provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and it is **not** a substitute for professional medical guidance. The use of Sai does **not** create a doctor-patient relationship. Any health-related content generated by Sai should not be acted upon without first consulting a qualified healthcare provider.

SiPhox disclaims any liability for decisions made based on information provided by Sai. By using Sai, you acknowledge and agree to these limitations and to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

### **🔨 Why We Built This**

# **The Problem: Blood Testing Is Stuck in the Past**

We live in a world where wearables track heart rate, sleep, and glucose 24/7, yet blood testing—the most critical health data source—is still:

🚫 **Infrequent** – Most people only test once per year at a doctor's visit.

🚫 **Incomplete** – Many key biomarkers are not tested until symptoms appear.

🚫 **Inconvenient** – Booking an appointment, traveling to a lab, and waiting weeks for results is a hassle.

🚫 **Painful** – Finger pricks and venous blood draws deter regular tracking.

🚫 **Fragmented** – No easy way to combine biomarker data with wearables or look at trends in past blood test data.

Meanwhile, people want more and better **insights into their health**, whether for **longevity, athletic performance, metabolic health, hormonal balance, chronic disease prevention, or chronic disease management.**

# **The Solution: Convenient Biomarker Tracking + Personalized Health Insights**

🔬 We spent the last **2.5 years** **experimenting** with at-home blood test kit offerings to solve this problem and **tested tens of thousands of people**.

With the **SiPhox Health Ultimate Program**, we brought blood biomarker tracking, painless home sample collection, advanced biomarkers, personalized insights, body composition, and wearable integration into one seamless platform—so you can take control of your health without paperwork, clinics, finger pricks, or expensive lab tests.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/8ea35ddb-b0ed-49ad-8fe6-1a39abf649eb)

We’ve since served **10s of thousands** of users. Here are our **learnings**:

1. More biomarkers = Better insights
   * Larger panels are more likely to uncover issues before they become serious
   * Users can handle (and often crave) more health data as long as it’s placed in proper context and made easy to understand
   * Biomarkers like ApoB, Ferritin, C-Peptide, Testosterone and others that are normally not tested without symptoms can often reveal early warning signs that can be reversed with low-effort interventions
2. Finger pricks don't work for everybody. Some people don’t mind them at all but they deter many from maintaining regular testing.
3. Comprehensive home blood testing can make a big difference in people’s lives. A few examples below in the words of our users:

Add these to the SiPhox panel for a more complete picture of your health.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/78cf4613-c1de-434f-b38b-a62eadd72733)

launches.tagline: Upload your recent blood test results for free and receive a clear, easy-to-understand analysis of your health data.
launches.body:
## **TL; DR:**

Trying to understand your blood test results shouldn't be a confusing or frustrating experience. At SiPhox Health, we simplify your lab results, offering clear insights into your health, actionable steps to improve it, and affordable at-home tests to track your progress. Say goodbye to cluttered, overwhelming reports, and hello to a healthier, more informed you.

**🔗Link to try it out:** <https://siphoxhealth.com/understand-your-test-results>

## **🚨 The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83565&key=user_uploads/520037/b16be89b-06df-4b1c-8919-382ec764ecf1)

**60% of American adults** are living with at least one chronic illness, and **40%** are living with two or more. Regular blood tests are vital for identifying and managing these conditions, but the traditional reports often add to the confusion.

Instead of offering clarity, you're met with pages of numbers, confusing medical jargon, and reference ranges that merely tell you if you’re “in” or “out”. If you're lucky enough to discuss the results with your doctor, you might gain some clarity and a prescription, but you’re unlikely to fully understand the status of your body, and feel like you have a clear plan to improve your health.

What's more, as long as your results aren't drastically abnormal, you might not receive any feedback from your doctor at all. This can lead to the neglect of critical signals—issues that may only become apparent when they escalate, often surfacing only a year later in your next annual blood test.

## 💡 **The SiPhox Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83565&key=user_uploads/520037/a84c1e65-96d2-494d-aab4-d8d097d3908f)

Check out a demo of the dashboard here: <https://app.siphoxhealth.com/reports/demo-siphox-dashboard>

We’ve developed a platform that turns your blood test results into actionable insights, empowering you to understand your body, make informed changes to improve your health and track your progress over time.

1. Understand your body
   * Simple explanations for each test, and insights to help you understand what your result for that test means.
2. Make changes.
   * Personalized diet, lifestyle, and supplement recommendations based on your blood test results and health goals. Our bodies are unique, complex systems, for which general recommendations will not suffice. Your action plan will be made custom for you.
3. Track progress.
   * How do you know if the changes have been effective? Take another blood test with a SiPhox at-home testing kit. SiPhox offers the most comprehensive and inexpensive at-home blood test kit on the market.
   * Visualize how your biomarkers are trending on simple, intuitive graphs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83565&key=user_uploads/520037/a67fa2bf-4ccc-453f-8ede-b5db1b40f41e)

## **How did we develop our algorithms:**

We run a mail-in blood testing subscription service ([$165 for quarterly testing](https://siphoxhealth.com)) that enables users to test 17 key blood biomarkers from home with a painless self-collected sample. We trained an AI algorithm on the massive amount of biomarker data we’ve collected over the years, coupled with all the insights our clinical team delivered to our subscribers.

## **How it works:**

1. **Upload Your Results:** You can upload blood test results from any doctor or provider by either uploading a file or manually entering them.

launches.body:
SiPhox is building at-home blood testing hardware using silicon photonic chips. Our hardware product is currently in development and we plan to start beta testing it in users’ homes in 2023. ([Watch Lab Tour](https://youtu.be/u6oF_lyUsII)).

**The average American lifespan has plateaued over the last 2 decades:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=66235&key=user_uploads/520037/ae9a0197-58ee-4f23-884b-e894463751d3)

We believe that every human is unique. Biomarker tracking is required to know whether a particular lifestyle or health intervention is working. At scale, we envision that frequent population biomarker tracking will enable humans to live longer and healthier lives.

**To enable this future, our team is working to decrease the cost of at-home testing by 10x and make results available immediately.**

**SiPhox just launched Quantify, an at-home test kit service that enables users to track 17 health tests ($95/test)** 🩸 **+ sleep, activity, and heart rate data from your wearable device ⌚ in a single dashboard.** [JOIN QUANTIFY (10% off)](https://getquantify.io/pages/tier-page?utm_source=YC-launch&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=YC-launch&utm_id=YC-launch)

### About Quantify

* Quantify was created to empower individuals to take control of their health journey.
* Quantify is a simple, convenient, low-cost, and comprehensive way to track your health and minimize chronic disease risk.
* We measure inflammation, metabolic fitness, hormonal + nutritional balance, and cardiovascular health. These are shown in a comprehensive, easy-to-understand wellness dashboard ([sample dashboard](https://app.getquantify.io/reports/d3e8b07917dba)) with personalized insights so you can track and improve over time.
* For now, all the tests are done via **mail-in,** **self-collected samples** at a **gold standard CLIA-certified lab**, SiPhox hardware will be phased in next year.
* **Over the last 3 months, our alpha users discovered and improved things like low Vit. D, high inflammation (hsCRP), low Testosterone, High ApoB/LDL cholesterol, high fasting Insulin, poor sleep, and more.**
* We want this sort of tracking to be broadly accessible to those that can’t afford concierge medicine. **At $95/kit for the monthly membership (before discount) we set the lowest price on the market (compare to $250 for Insidetracker InnerAge 2.0).**
